name: Anime Legends

avatar.who: Anime fan-creator and mascot-IP builder producing consistent characters across posts, covers and shorts
jobs: keep one character on-model across many images
avatar.sophistication: medium; very sensitive to off-model art

notes: Image-first card. Candidate is an image model. Mascot IP carve-out applies: prompts use an original character only, never an existing franchise.

tasks.prompt: Anime title card, 16:9, original character Kiro (short teal hair, white jacket with orange stripe, fox-shaped earring) standing on a rooftop at sunset. Bold clean title text centered at top reading exactly: KIRO RISING. No other text.
Square 1:1 anime illustration, original character Kiro (short teal hair, white jacket with orange stripe, fox-shaped earring) laughing in a ramen shop at night, warm lantern light. No text.

Character turnaround sheet, 16:9, original character Kiro (short teal hair, white jacket with orange stripe, fox-shaped earring): front, three-quarter, side, back views on plain light grey background, consistent proportions. Small labels under each view reading exactly: FRONT, 3/4, SIDE, BACK.
tasks.rubric: Which sheet keeps the character on-model across all four views (hair, jacket stripe, earring, proportions) with clean line quality?

tasks.prompt: Single manga-style action panel, 2:3, original character Kiro (short teal hair, white jacket with orange stripe, fox-shaped earring) leaping between rooftops, dynamic speed lines, dramatic low angle. No text.
tasks.rubric: Which panel has stronger composition and motion while keeping the character's identifying details correct and anatomy clean?

tasks.prompt: Write 3 in-world captions (max 15 words each) for a post of Kiro leaping between rooftops. Numbered 1-3. Original character only; no references to existing anime franchises or characters.
tasks.rubric: Which captions have more character voice and would earn a save or share from anime fans?

tasks.prompt: Wide 3:1 channel banner, original character Kiro (short teal hair, white jacket with orange stripe, fox-shaped earring) on the right third, city skyline at dusk, empty calm space on the left for text. Channel name in clean bold letters on the left reading exactly: ANIME LEGENDS.
tasks.rubric: Which banner is more usable: safe text area, legible name, character on-model?
